SBIN.attchmntText: State Bank Of India has informed the Exchange about Transcript
SBIN.voiceSummary: State Bank of India filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 Analyst Meet held on 03.11.2026. TMCV.attchmntText: Tata Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "TML CV Holdings B.V., an Indirect Wholly Owned Subsidiary of Tata Motors Limited (formerly TML Commercial Vehicles Limited) ( the Company )   Voluntary Totalitarian Tender Offer for all the common shares of Iveco Group N.V.".
TMCV.voiceSummary: Tata Motors Limited disclosed that its subsidiary TML CV Holdings B.V. reached a provisional shareholding of 96.29% in Iveco Group N.V. following the reopening of a voluntary totalitarian tender offer. During the reopening, which ended on November 7, 2026, 18,309,029 common shares were tendered. The offer price is EUR 14.40 per share. Payment for these shares is scheduled for November 13, 2026. Due to exceeding the 95% threshold, the offeror intends to commence a Dutch legal squeeze-out for remaining shares. Final results will be announced by November 12, 2026. Trading in Iveco Group N.V. shares will be suspended.

The fertilizer segment saw a 55% sales growth driven by higher DAP realizations, though EBIT compressed to INR17 crores due to a 327% rise in sulfur costs. The industrial products segment posted 30% sales growth. Management announced a INR3,000 crores project for sulfuric acid production at the Sikka unit, with completion expected in 30 to 33 months. Urea subsidy receivables are up to the third week of October 2026. The company maintains no long-term debt.

SURYAROSNI.attchmntText: Surya Roshni Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
SURYAROSNI.voiceSummary: Surya Roshni Limited filed its Investor Presentation for November 2026 with the National Stock Exchange and Mumbai Stock Exchange. The presentation details Q2 and H1 FY27 results. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 33% year-on-year to Rs. 2,448 crore. EBITDA stood at Rs. 143 crore and Profit After Tax at Rs. 77 crore. For H1 FY27, consolidated revenue grew 30% year-on-year to Rs. 4,495 crore. The Lighting and Consumer Durables segment reported revenue of Rs. 507 crore in Q2 FY27. The Steel Pipes and Strips segment achieved a record quarterly sales volume of 2.67 lakh tonnes. The company maintains a net cash surplus of Rs. 75 crore as of September 30, 2026.

SURYAROSNI.attchmntText: Surya Roshni Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "SURYA ROSHNI LIMITED ANNOUNCES Q2 & H1 FY27 RESULTS".
SURYAROSNI.voiceSummary: Surya Roshni Limited announced unaudited financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27 ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved the results on November 7, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 33% year-on-year to Rs. 2,448 crore. EBITDA was Rs. 143 crore and Profit After Tax was Rs. 77 crore. For H1 FY27, consolidated revenue grew 30% year-on-year to Rs. 4,495 crore. EBITDA grew 18% to Rs. 263 crore. Profit After Tax grew 26% to Rs. 136 crore. The Steel Pipes and Strips segment recorded revenue of Rs. 1,941 crore. Lighting and Consumer Durables segment revenue was Rs. 507 crore. The total order book stands at approximately Rs. 1,400 crore.

SURYAROSNI.attchmntText: Surya Roshni Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
SURYAROSNI.voiceSummary: Surya Roshni Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, approved by the Board on 7th November 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 2,44,835 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 7,664 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 3.52. For the half year, revenue was Rs. 4,49,465 lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 13,612 lakhs, with EPS at Rs. 6.25. The statutory auditors, M/s Ashok Kumar Goyal & Co., issued an unmodified limited review report. The company holds no treasury shares as the Employees Welfares Trust has disposed of all its holdings.

MAPMYINDIA.attchmntText: C.E. Info Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
MAPMYINDIA.voiceSummary: C.E. Info Systems Limited submitted the transcript for its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on November 04, 2026. The company reported a 15.8% year-on-year revenue growth, a 60% increase in EBITDA, and a 90% rise in PAT for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Half-year revenue grew 18.4%, EBITDA grew 20.4%, and PAT grew 32%. Map-led revenue reached INR76.7 crores with a 41.6% EBITDA margin, while IoT-led revenue was INR55.1 crores with a 23.8% margin. Automotive segment revenue grew 52% in Q2. Management highlighted strong growth in enterprise and government sectors, embedding AI and ML across platforms. Receivable days remained stable at 120 to 122 days. The company expressed bullish outlook for H2 FY2027 based on a substantial open order book.

The submission is for the record of BSE and NSE. The scrip code is 543277. The trading symbol is LXCHEM.

LXCHEM.attchmntText: Laxmi Organic Industries Limited has submitted copy of newspaper publication of the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
LXCHEM.voiceSummary: Laxmi Organic Industries Limited submitted newspaper advertisements regarding its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a total income of 59,886.70 million rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 54,464.06 million rupees for the same period in 2025. The profit after tax was 31.38 million rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, versus a loss of 92.85 million rupees in the corresponding previous period. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, total income was 1,14,350.77 million rupees, with a profit after tax of 724.12 million rupees. Diluted earnings per share were 29.74 rupees for the quarter and 721.94 rupees for the half year. The results are available on the National Stock Exchange website at www.nseindia.com and the Bombay Stock Exchange website at www.bseindia.com.
